purpose: marketplace listing-language evidence for the style vocabularies and confusable_with edges. evidence only: nothing here authors vocabulary content without review
method_notes: ebay style assignment is deterministic title matching (a listing can match several styles). etsy rows carry their search query. solimet_title_check is a deterministic offline filter flagging stone/plastic terms in titles; false negatives possible (listing photos may show stones). apify free-plan dataset retention is 7 days; these files are the durable snapshot. the skonvirke and scandinavian-modern queries (2026-10-08 follow-up) are kept as raw listings under style_query organic_modern and are not folded into phrase-frequencies.jsonl, to avoid double-counting that style's bucket.
